text: Three students from Volda University College set out to film a documentary about Hans, a suspected bear poacher, and follow him into a forest at night where lights flash and something roars. Hans is really a hunter of trolls, working for a secret service that [plants fake bear tracks to hide them|threat|the powerful and their systems]. Carrying a UV flash-gun that [turns trolls to stone|rules|it has a fatal weakness], he lets the cameras follow as the hunt leads north into [troll territory|images|wild and lonely places].
